verdict.rationale: The only concrete limit figures (30s CPU on the free tier, 15 minutes on paid plans) come from a community comment, not first-party docs. Vendor material says billing counts compute rather than wall time during long agent workflows, and that Workflows can persist state for minutes to weeks, which hints at a path for long-running jobs. missing for 10: a first-party limits page stating CPU-time and wall-clock caps per plan and per invocation type (HTTP, cron, Queues, Durable Objects/Agents), explicit wall-clock duration limits, and independent corroboration of the figures.
